title: Proof-Grounded Patient-Specific Clinical Explanations from Knowledge-Graph Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.06549v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Clinical decision support can lack auditable links from observations and encoded knowledge to conclusions and recommendations. Downstream of a frozen, training-free clinical knowledge-graph reasoner, the CKG Clinical Explanation Engine converts patient inference states and disease knowledge into typed facts, explicit rule traces, provenance-linked conclusions, and policy-licensed recommendations. Separate availability, representation completeness, and disease-specific activation distinguish observed zero-activation and partial evidence from unobserved evidence. Language-generation evaluation remains future work. Across six usable workbooks (11,289 patients, 33,867 patient-disease traces, 1,715,928 feature-evidence rows), IG-range validity, knowledge provenance, cross-sheet numerical fidelity (203,202/203,202), and exported fact/report field presence (33,867/33,867) reached 100.00%. Availability-representation consistency reached 99.2

translated_title: 基于知识图谱推理的循证患者特异性临床解释
translated_abstract: 临床决策支持系统往往缺乏从观察和编码知识到结论与建议之间的可审计链接。在一个冻结的、免训练的临床知识图谱推理器的下游，CKG 临床解释引擎将患者推理状态和疾病知识转换为类型化事实、显式规则追踪、带溯源链接的结论以及符合政策许可的建议。通过区分可用性、表示完整性和疾病特异性激活，该引擎能够将观察到的零激活和部分证据与未观察到的证据区分开来。语言生成评估仍是未来的工作。在六个可用的数据工作簿（11,289 名患者、33,867 条患者-疾病追踪记录、1,715,928 行特征-证据数据）上，IG 范围有效性、知识溯源、跨工作表数值保真度（203,202/203,202）以及导出事实/报告字段完整性（33,867/33,867）均达到 100.00%。可用性-表示一致性达到 99.2%。
tldr: 该论文提出 CKG 临床解释引擎，在免训练的临床知识图谱推理器下游将患者推理状态转化为可审计、带溯源链接且符合政策许可的临床解释，并在逾万名患者的大规模数据上验证了事实与报告的完整性和数值保真度。
en_tdlr: The CKG Clinical Explanation Engine converts patient inference states downstream of a frozen, training-free clinical knowledge-graph reasoner into auditable, provenance-linked, policy-licensed clinical explanations, achieving 100% fact/report completeness across 11,289 patients.
